eligibility: single-gene condition with >=60 cells in EACH of four pools defined as (gemgroup-1) modulo 4; common task list for all modes/seeds
control_matching: within each A/B/C arm, match control cell counts to perturbed cell counts for every GEM/library group
control_null_matching: 60 pseudo-perturbed and 60 matched control cells in each A/B/C arm, disjoint from D and one another
disjoint_library_pools: A/B/C/D assigned successive modulo-4 pools with rotations 0,1,2; D uses controls only
random_cell_pools: control cells partitioned within each library into A/B/C/D; perturbed cells sampled into three disjoint equal-size arms
primary_response: mean of independent signed delta_B * delta_C for genes selected by A/D ranking
scope: all curated HVGs plus targets, direct target excluded; original whole-matrix reconciliation separate
claims_limit: GEM groups are technical libraries, not independent biological replicates. Tasks reuse controls. No confirmatory p-values or novel-method superiority claim.
